保留原始对话与事件时间，保存后保留旧版本。: The source conversation, event time, and previous version are preserved.
以所属 Agent 的“我”来记述；他人的经历保留“我得知”等信息来源。: Write from the owning Agent's perspective using “I”. Attribute others' experiences, for example, “I learned that…”.
使用客观事实表述。旧事实保留在历史中，对象与原始观察时间不变。: Use objective statements. The previous fact stays in history; its subject and original observation time remain unchanged.
每行一项，留空可清除。: One item per line. Leave blank to clear.
每组最多 100 项，每项最多 200 字。: Up to 100 items per group and 200 characters per item.
不选则保留原向量，文本搜索仍会更新；语义相似度可能继续反映旧内容。: If unchecked, the existing embedding is kept. Text search updates, but semantic similarity may still reflect the previous content.
保存未完成，请保留编辑内容并重试。: Saving did not complete. Keep your draft and try again.
草稿已保留。请先复制正文，再关闭并刷新条目，避免覆盖较新的修改。: Your draft is preserved. Copy the content, then close and refresh the entry to avoid overwriting newer changes.
保存为新修订，不修改来源对话。: Saves a new revision without changing the source conversation.
修改已保存，旧版本已保留。: Changes saved. The previous version is preserved.
重新纳入有效事实，保留原始来源与时间。: Make this fact active again, preserving its original source and time.
